text: Grab's FY2025 report flags a potential Indonesian **draft presidential decree** that could lower the current 20% driver-partner commission cap (a 15% commission cap plus a 5% optional supporting fee cap under Ministry of Transportation Decree No. 667 of 2022, as amended) down to a **flat 10% commission cap**. The same draft decree, as reported by media, would also reclassify driver-partners as quasi-employees—requiring Grab to fund accident/death insurance and contribute to health, old-age, and pension premiums—allow government review of driver-partner agreements, and protect their right to unionize [Grab, FY2025, p.16].
